column4: Arithmetic, arrays, structs, strings, printf. Straight Flow to C to wasm32 with nothing else linked in.
runtime/gfx_wasm.c paints the framebuffer onto a canvas and maps DOM key events to the macOS keycodes the programs already use.

digits_mlp_parallel and parallel_sum run on real Emscripten pthreads over SharedArrayBuffer and Web Workers. SharedArrayBuffer needs a cross-origin-isolated page, so open those cards in a tab and let their service worker reload once.

tcp_echo is a gallery card. It uses Flow's BSD socket API (runtime/flow_tcp.c). In the browser, connect() is a WebSocket, so start ./flow tool ws_echo_relay --port 9505 and open the card. Without the relay the program times out and exits 1. The same source also runs natively against the relay's TCP port.
WebGPU, with WGSL generated from the same @gpu AST that already emits Metal. Not built here.
Pyodide, which is CPython itself compiled to WebAssembly. Not built here.
Emscripten's MEMFS and IDBFS filesystems. Not wired into these pages.
The miniaudio and Metal audio backends have no browser counterpart here yet; WebAudio would be the route.
